summary: Backend and frontend smoke testing of portfolio site. All 4 backend endpoint scenarios pass (GET /api/, POST /api/contact valid, POST /api/contact invalid email 422, POST /api/contact missing fields 422, GET /api/contact). Frontend home loads with hero name 'Bernardo Borges' and 'Software Engineer' title. All 6 nav links and both hero CTAs present. Projects section renders all 4 project cards (taca-ua, secure-doc, astratd, evsync) with external links defined in data. Contact form: valid submission shows success toast ('Message received. I will be in touch.'), form clears, message persisted to MongoDB (verified via GET /api/contact). Invalid email blocked by native HTML5 validation, inputs preserved.
passed: POST /api/contact valid payload returns 200 with id and created_at
GET /api/contact returns list of stored messages including T1 Bot submission
Frontend loads with Bernardo Borges / Software Engineer hero
4 project cards rendered: taca-ua, secure-doc, astratd, evsync (with external links in data)
Contact form valid submit: success toast displayed, form cleared, persisted to backend
Contact form invalid email: submission blocked, inputs preserved
notes: Project card testid for Secure Document Repository is 'project-card-secure-doc' (not 'project-card-secure-doc-repo' as listed in request) - all 4 cards still render correctly
Invalid email is caught by native HTML5 browser validation (input type=email) rather than custom toast; inputs are preserved as required
